text: For the director of music. A maskil of David. When Doeg the Edomite had gone to Saul and told him: “David has gone to the house of Ahimelech.” Why do you boast of evil, you mighty man? Why do you boast all day long, you who are a disgrace in the eyes of God?
it is like a sharpened razor, you who practice deceit.
falsehood rather than speaking the truth. Selah
He will snatch you up and tear you from your tent; he will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah
they will laugh at him, saying,
who did not make God his stronghold but trusted in his great wealth and grew strong by destroying others!”
flourishing in the house of God; I trust in God’s unfailing love for ever and ever.
in your name I will hope, for your name is good. I will praise you in the presence of your saints.
